tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper #FFFFFF, the reading ground of every light theme and the text colour on accent fills.

tokens.name: data-sand
tokens.usage: Sand, the one second data colour, only when two curves must be told apart. 1.45:1 on paper, so a two-series chart runs on a `.dark` board (8.7:1 on blue-dark). Never a fill behind content.

tokens.name: duo-highlight
tokens.usage: Web duotone highlight #8FC9F5 (Public imagery mode). Pairs with `duo-shadow` at a 60% blend. Photographs only.

tokens.name: duo-deck-highlight
tokens.usage: Petrol deck duotone highlight #73BFB4, applied through an SVG feComponentTransfer on petrol boards. Pairs with `duo-deck-shadow`.

tokens.name: duo-shadow
tokens.usage: Web duotone shadow #0F3557 (Public imagery mode). Pairs with `duo-highlight`. Photographs only.

tokens.name: duo-deck-shadow
tokens.usage: Petrol deck duotone shadow #062020. Pairs with `duo-deck-highlight`. Photographs only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground of the current theme: paper on light themes, the palette's dark band on dark themes. Every text role below is checked against it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, claims and body copy on `surface`. 12.5:1 or better in every theme.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, meta, chart labels on `surface` and `band`. At least 5.1:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: The least important text still meant to be read, always paired with italic, on `surface`: 4.6:1 or better in every theme. On `band` it misses 4.5:1 in the blue (4.26:1) and petrol (4.40:1) themes, so keep soft text off tinted bands there.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline: rows, section dividers, chart axes and grid. Decorative separators at 1.5 to 1.8:1; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The theme accent: links, the primary block, focus ring, icons, chart series 1. At least 6.4:1 on `surface` in every theme. On light themes it is Clinical Blue, petrol or violet; petrol and violet only beside the topic's name.

tokens.name: onacc
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an `accent` fill (the primary block). At least 6.4:1 in every theme; on dark themes it is the band colour, not white.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: A topic card or topic page's own ground (light themes only).

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The tinted section stripe, level 1 of the surface ladder (light themes only). Violet uses its own band #F4ECFA.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axis lines: the hairline `rule`.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines: the hairline `rule`.

tokens.name: chart-label
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick values in Geist Mono: `muted`.

tokens.name: chart-series-1
tokens.usage: The first (and usually only) chart series: the theme accent.

tokens.name: chart-series-2
tokens.usage: The second series, sand, only when two curves must be told apart and only on a dark board. Also dashed or marked, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-series-1-a75
tokens.usage: Accent at 75%: second step of the opacity ladder for ranked or stacked categories.

tokens.name: chart-series-1-a50
tokens.usage: Accent at 50%: third step of the opacity ladder.

tokens.name: chart-series-1-a25
tokens.usage: Accent at 25%: fourth step of the opacity ladder; also range spans in a risk stack. A fifth category is a second chart.

tokens.name: chart-emphasis
tokens.usage: The one emphasised data point, drawn in ink, larger, value labelled.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of `ink`: reading text and headings.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of `muted`: supporting copy, meta, captions.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of `soft`: subordinate text, paired with italic, never made paler.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of `accent`: links and the "more" affordance.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of `onacc`: text on the primary block.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text the colour of the surface, for type knocked out of an ink or accent fill. Rare.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Level 0, the reading ground (alias of `surface`).

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Level 1, the tinted section stripe (alias of `band`).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Level 2, a white sheet on a hairline. Deprecated as a card on the web (structure is a hairline, never a card); kept for decks and handouts.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: A topic card's own ground (alias of `tint`).

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Level 3, punctuation: utility strip, scrim, closing CTA. At most twice a page. White text clears 12.6:1 on the blue band.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline (alias of `rule`).

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: A row or mark on hover or open: the accent.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid outline at 3px offset, in the accent. Never removed without a replacement.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary block (the square accent button that replaced the pill).

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Text on the primary block.

tokens.name: action-ghost-border
tokens.usage: Legacy outline pill border. The web ghost action is now an accent underline.

tokens.name: action-ghost-text
tokens.usage: Text of the ghost action: the accent.

tokens.name: icon-default
tokens.usage: Icon strokes: the accent. Icons are currentColor, so this is the colour of their container.

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary icon strokes: `muted`.

tokens.name: scrim-photo
tokens.usage: Photo scrim, blue-dark at 50%. Required under any text on a Public (duotoned) photograph; raise to .62 or use a solid panel on Clinical photographs. Always a real background colour, never a gradient alone.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Surface ladder level 0: paper.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Surface ladder level 1: the band.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Surface ladder level 2: a white sheet.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Surface ladder level 3: the blue dark band.

tokens.name: signal-positive-ink
tokens.usage: Positive verdict text (benefit, do, fact), only where she states a verdict. Clears 5.9:1 or better on paper and on its `-soft` tint. Warm/cool pair, never red/green; the word is always printed.

tokens.name: signal-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tint a positive row or chip sits on.

tokens.name: signal-positive-edge
tokens.usage: Rule or bar in a positive row.

tokens.name: signal-positive-on-dark
tokens.usage: Positive verdict on a dark board (6.5:1 or better on blue-dark).

tokens.name: signal-negative-ink
tokens.usage: Negative verdict text (risk, don't, myth), only where she states a verdict. Clears 5.9:1 or better on paper and on its `-soft` tint. Warm/cool pair, never red/green; the word is always printed.

tokens.name: signal-negative-soft
tokens.usage: Tint a negative row or chip sits on.

tokens.name: signal-negative-edge
tokens.usage: Rule or bar in a negative row.

tokens.name: signal-negative-on-dark
tokens.usage: Negative verdict on a dark board (6.5:1 or better on blue-dark).

tokens.name: signal-caution-ink
tokens.usage: Caution verdict text (caution, a mortality range), only where she states a verdict. Clears 5.9:1 or better on paper and on its `-soft` tint. Warm/cool pair, never red/green; the word is always printed.

tokens.name: signal-caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tint a caution row or chip sits on.

tokens.name: signal-caution-edge
tokens.usage: Rule or bar in a caution row.

tokens.name: signal-caution-on-dark
tokens.usage: Caution verdict on a dark board (6.5:1 or better on blue-dark).

tokens.name: signal-neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Neutral verdict text: `muted`.

tokens.name: signal-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral row ground: `band`.

tokens.name: signal-neutral-edge
tokens.usage: Neutral rule or bar: `rule`.

tokens.name: signal-neutral-on-dark
tokens.usage: Neutral verdict on a dark board: `muted`.

tokens.name: grade-5
tokens.usage: Evidence ladder, strongest rung: the theme accent at full value. Grades are shown only where she or the source states them.

tokens.name: grade-4
tokens.usage: Evidence ladder rung 4: accent at 78%.

tokens.name: grade-3
tokens.usage: Evidence ladder rung 3: accent at 56%.

tokens.name: grade-2
tokens.usage: Evidence ladder rung 2: accent at 34%.

tokens.name: grade-1
tokens.usage: Evidence ladder, weakest rung: the hairline `rule` (1.8:1 on paper). The rung is always labelled in text, never told apart by fill alone.

color.note: Themes: `light` is the blue theme (the default, and the only chrome theme); `t-petrol` and `t-violet` are topic themes; the three `-dark` themes are dark punctuation bands, not a dark mode. Components read the semantic names (surface, ink, muted, soft, rule, accent, onacc), never a palette primitive.
